visual_style: Natural smartphone selfie video, daylight, realistic, lightly handheld

concept.title: Still ice at 5 PM
concept.angle: Honest end-of-day proof moment: she shakes the tumbler and the ice from the morning still rattles.
concept.hook: The sound and sight of ice rattling at the end of a workday, tumbler close to the lens in the first second.
concept.key_message: Arka keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours.
concept.target_audience: Office workers and commuters, 22–35, hot-climate city
alternatives_considered: Problem→solution: melted-ice plastic cup vs tumbler (needs two props and a cut, too much for 8 s)
Leak test: tumbler upside-down in a tote bag (leak-proof claim, but weaker visual hook)

script: Seven a.m. ice… still here. Arka keeps drinks cold up to twenty-four hours. Link in bio!
claims_used: Keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours

storyboard.setting: Modern office desk by a window, late afternoon
storyboard.lighting: Warm window light from camera left
storyboard.framing: Medium close-up, eye level, phone held at arm's length (selfie)
storyboard.action: She lifts the sage-green tumbler close to the lens and gives it a gentle shake
storyboard.gestures: Tumbler held in right hand, label side towards camera
storyboard.product_visibility: Fills the lower third of frame, embossed wordmark visible

storyboard.dialogue: Arka keeps drinks cold up to twenty-four hours.

Keep hair exactly as in the references; no hair change in this production.

flow_prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 smartphone selfie video, medium close-up, eye level, handheld with subtle natural shake, one continuous take. The woman from the reference images, wearing a plain light-coloured office top, sits at a modern office desk by a window in late-afternoon light coming from the left. 0–2s: she lifts a sage-green insulated tumbler close to the lens and gently shakes it, eyebrows raised, and says to camera: "Seven a.m. ice… still here." 2–5s: she pulls it back to chest height, flips the white lid open with her thumb, glances inside, nods and smiles: "Arka keeps drinks cold up to twenty-four hours." 5–8s: she closes the lid and points down with a warm smile: "Link in bio!" Keep the tumbler's exact shape, colour and embossed wordmark from the product image. Natural skin texture, realistic hands with five fingers, true-to-life phone colour, slight auto-exposure shift, no on-screen text, no music, soft office room tone.
flow_prompts.dialogue: Seven a.m. ice… still here. Arka keeps drinks cold up to twenty-four hours. Link in bio!
